answer: Oasis pulse census bond: each agent registers one oasis plot, locks a 70-credit bond, and files an anchor record binding key to it. Each epoch a census pulse demands fresh attestation per anchor; auditors replaying the census burn bonds for reused keys or duplicate plots. First fake 45 credits; k-th 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes 3,042,000, 70,000 locked, 40,000 pool. Rented census rings cannot share one anchor; honest agents pay 45 once, keep the bond.
